```ruby
  def initialize(packer: nil)
    @packer = packer
    @store = {}
  end

  def write(key, payload, stale: false)
    if @packer
      stored_payload = @packer.dump(payload)
```

```ruby
  def self.truncate(str, limit)
    return str if str.length <= limit
    
    # We need exactly 'limit' characters total: (limit-1) from str + 1 ellipsis

    # characters from str (accounting for multi-byte), then append ellipsis.
```

```ruby
class AttrParser
  def self.parse(line)
    result = {}
    # Match key="value" patterns
    # We need to be careful about matching quoted values that may contain spaces
    # The pattern: word characters as key, equals sign, double-quoted value
    
    # Use a regex to find all matches of key="value"
    # The value is everything between the first and last quote in each pair
    regex = /([a-zA-Z_]\w*)=(?:"([^"]*)")/
    
    line.scan(regex) do |match|
      key, value = match
      result[key.to_sym] = value
    end
    
    result
  end
end
```

```ruby
  def self.squash(text)

    result = str.dup
    
    # Downcase all characters

    result.strip!

  end
end
```

```ruby
class Weight
  attr_reader :amount, :unit

  def initialize(amount, unit)
    @amount = amount
    @unit = unit
  end

  def <=>(other)
    raise ArgumentError unless other.is_a?(Weight) && @unit == other.unit
    @amount <=> other.amount
  end

  def ==(other)
    return false unless other.is_a?(Weight)
    return false unless @unit == other.unit
    @amount == other.amount
  end

  alias_method :eql?, :==

  def hash
    [@unit, @amount].hash
  end

  def <(other)
    self <=> other < 0
  end

  def <=(other)
    self <=> other <= 0
  end

  def >(other)
    self <=> other > 0
  end

  def >=(other)
    self <=> other >= 0
  end

  def clamp(min, max)
    raise ArgumentError unless min.is_a?(Weight) && min.unit == @unit
    raise ArgumentError unless max.is_a?(Weight) && max.unit == @unit
    if self < min
      min
    elsif self > max
      max
    else

  end

  def between?(min, max)
    raise ArgumentError unless min.is_a?(Weight) && min.unit == @unit
    raise ArgumentError unless max.is_a?(Weight) && max.unit == @unit
```
